svg.text: Nothing to hold. The two coloured thumb keys switch layers: green = Layer 1, orange = Layer 2.
HOLD the green thumb key (left hand, outer) and press the keys below with the other fingers.
HOLD the orange thumb key (right hand, outer) and press the keys below.
HOLD the green AND the orange thumb keys together (one per thumb), then press a key below.
Grey key = transparent (does what the base layer does). Thick-bordered keys are the layer keys.
